Embedding request with multiple inputs returns multiple embedding objects

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.embeddingRequestFromJson("{\"input\":[\"Hello world\",\"Goodbye world\"],\"model\":\"text-embedding-3-small\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.embed(request: _request)
print(result)
```
